raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 13 (ingested 2026-01-18) delivered txn_ts as 13-digit epoch milliseconds instead of 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' strings, so the TIMESTAMP cast fails. That makes the conversion unambiguous.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.86, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, ts AS txn_ts, CAST(ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN regexp_full_match(trim(txn_ts), '[0-9]{13}') THEN epoch_ms(CAST(trim(txn_ts) AS BIGINT)) WHEN regexp_full_match(trim(txn_ts), '[0-9]{10}') THEN epoch_ms(CAST(trim(txn_ts) AS BIGINT) * 1000) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') s"}}
